description:
Add rustdoc to the filter algebra types in crate-jmap-contacts-types documenting their exclusion from the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy "Decision: filter algebra excluded", 2026-05-10).

## Types in scope

- `crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/card.rs:192` — `ContactCardFilterCondition`
- `crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/card.rs:286` — `ContactCardComparator`

## Required rustdoc content

Mirror canonical wording from .1 (jmap-types) and .2 (jmap-mail-types) per cookie-cutter rule. Each type carries:
- exclusion notice,
- three-reason rationale,
- IETF-track future hook pointing at `draft-ietf-jmap-metadata` / workspace tracker JMAP-06zp,
- pre-IETF escape (sloppy-value `serde_json::Value` or fork FilterCondition),
- JMAP-lbdy cross-reference.

## Acceptance criteria

- Both types carry the exclusion notice with wording consistent with siblings and both future-hook paths.
- `cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-contacts-types` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-contacts-types -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types` clean.

No code changes beyond doc comments.
